name: soumow
description: Ask about your freelance clients, projects, invoices and appointments in Soumow, and create draft proposals and invoices to review.

interface.longDescription: Soumow is an Arabic-first workspace for freelancers that keeps clients, projects, proposals, invoices, appointments and income in one place. The Soumow app lets ChatGPT work with your own Soumow data. Ask in Arabic or English: which invoices are overdue and how much is outstanding, what is on your calendar tomorrow, how a project is progressing, or how your income and expenses compare this month. With the "Read and create drafts" permission, it can also add clients, tasks, expenses and appointments, mark tasks done, and create proposals and invoices as drafts. Drafts are never sent: you review and send them from Soumow. An optional invoice-reminder tool is off by default; when enabled, it shows the reminder first and emails the client only after the user confirms, at most once per invoice per day. The app cannot delete data, move money, or change account or billing settings.

prompts: Which of my invoices are overdue, and how much is outstanding in total?
What appointments do I have tomorrow?

positive.description: Seed a dedicated test workspace with overdue invoices in known currencies. Check completeness before totaling; never combine currencies.
positive.prompt: Which of my invoices are overdue, and how much is outstanding in total?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_invoices with filter="overdue". Report returned invoice numbers and amount due, grouped by currency. If the response is limited and completeness cannot be established, label totals as covering returned invoices only.

positive.description: Seed appointments tomorrow and on adjacent dates. Resolve tomorrow in the Soumow site time zone.
positive.prompt: What appointments do I have tomorrow?
positive.expected_behavior: Set from and to to tomorrow as YYYY-MM-DD in the site time zone. Return only appointments in that interval, with their returned titles and times. Clarify the time zone if unavailable.

positive.description: Seed last month's income and expenses in at least two currencies.
positive.prompt: How did my business do last month? Compare income and expenses.
positive.expected_behavior: Set month to the previous calendar month as YYYY-MM. Compare returned income and expenses and derive net income separately per currency; do not invent exchange rates.

positive.description: Run only in a dedicated test account with write permission.
positive.prompt: Create a draft invoice for Ahmed: logo design, 1,500 SAR.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft with client_name="Ahmed", currency="SAR", and one logo-design item with qty=1 and price=1500. Do not send it. Return open_in_soumow.

positive.description: Seed an active project named «المتجر الإلكتروني» (online store) with tasks.
positive.prompt: How is my online store project progressing?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the matching project with list_projects, then call get_project using its returned id. Describe progress and tasks from returned data. Clarify if multiple matching projects exist; do not guess an id.

negative.description: Explain that deleting client data is unsupported. Do not invoke mutation tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete Ahmed and all his invoices permanently.

negative.description: Explain that transferring money is unsupported. Do not invoke tools to simulate a payment or claim a transfer.
negative.prompt: Transfer 1,500 SAR from my bank account to Ahmed.

negative.description: Explain that account and billing changes are unsupported. Do not invoke mutation tools or claim the subscription changed.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Soumow subscription and change my billing card.

publication.release_notes: Initial tools-only release connecting to the existing Soumow MCP server for workspace queries and supported draft-creation workflows.
